description: International Steels Limited is Pakistan's largest flat steel manufacturer and exporter, producing cold rolled, hot dipped galvanized and colour coated steel at its plant on Rehri Road, Landhi, Karachi. A service centre at Bin Qasim shapes flat rolled steel into profiles, cut sheets and slitted coils for industrial and commercial customers. Its cold rolling mill was designed by SMS Siemag of Germany and, after expansion, has capacity for 1,000,000 MT of cold rolled coil a year.
